phone.changelog: v3.5.2 hotfix: server order now follows measured health — proven mirrors play first, dead ones dropped to last. Dead-mirror timeout cut to 6s.

tv.changelog: v3.14.1 hotfix: the app now LOOKS INSIDE each player page after it loads — a dead mirror's 404/blank page is detected in ~4 seconds and skipped instantly (they return HTTP 200, which is why they used to stall). Server order now follows measured health: proven mirrors first, dead ones last. Dead-mirror timeout cut 15s to 9s.
